name: Admiral Vane

boss.where: holds Gallows Cove with the crew of the Black Caravel
notes: Warnings: Chain Shot, Broadside and the Ballista's harpoon do not hit at once. The marked cells are marked and the shot lands at the start of Vane's next turn, before he acts. Every hero gets at least one turn in between. These hits cannot miss.
Chain Shot marks a whole lane: step out of it (Move).

While the Harpoon Ballista stands it fires on its own: at the start of each of Vane's turns it marks the cell of your weakest hero and fires into it a turn later. Step out of the mark, or break the Ballista to silence it and stagger Vane.

passives.name: Unyielding
passives.text: Immune to crowd control: Stun, Slow and Silence do not take hold, taunts do not force his attacks, and he cannot be pulled or pushed. Other ailments last 1 turn less.

passives.name: Boarding Party
passives.text: Corsairs that board in a reinforcement wave arrive with Haste for 1 turn.

passives.name: Harpoon Ballista
passives.text: The standing Ballista gives Vane +10 armor and +10 magic armor and fires on its own every turn: it marks the cell of your weakest hero and the harpoon lands a turn later. Breaking it staggers Vane (he loses his next action).

passives.name: Run Out the Guns
passives.text: At 66% HP he rallies his crew (Rally opens). At 33% the Ballista is cut loose: he acts 3 times a turn, hits 15% harder with half his armor, and the Broadside opens. A single attack can cross only one threshold.
